P1: 浅葱市 is a major port city located in northwest Johto, between 39号道路 to the north and 40号道路 to the west. The Olivine Gym stands in the north part of town, and the Olivine Lighthouse helps to guide ships like the S.S. Aqua into the harbor.
M1: The same as the traded Pokémon
D1: From the Fishing Guru in the house south of the Gym
D2: Held by Billy, a 霹雳电球 received through a trade
D3: North of the Poké Mart, on a lone rock behind the two houses (hidden)
D4: In the corner behind the Olivine Harbor building (hidden)
D5: Northeast of the lighthouse, on the small beach (requires 冲浪)
D7: From Gym Leader Jasmine, after saving Amphy and defeating her
D8: Olivine Harbor; southwest of the S.S. Aqua (hidden; requires 船票)
D9: Olivine Harbor building; from Professor Oak, after entering the Hall of Fame
D10: East of the lighthouse, on a lone rock (requires 攀岩)
P2: When you approach the Gym, 劲敌（西尔弗） is just leaving. He informs you that the Gym Leader is away at the lighthouse, taking care of a Pokémon that has fallen ill. He walks away, wondering aloud why she would do such a thing, as he firmly believes that any Pokémon unable to battle is worthless.
P3: Visit the first house to the south of the Gym and speak to the Fisherman inside to receive a 好钓竿. This mid-level fishing rod can reel in a greater variety of water-dwelling Pokémon than the 破旧钓竿.
P4: There are two houses standing side-by-side in the northeast part of town. Visit the western house to find a man who would like to trade Pokémon. He is willing to part with his 霹雳电球 in exchange for a 大钳蟹. Krabby can be found in 浅葱市 and on 40号道路 to the west, and is an easy catch with a 好钓竿.
P5: The Olivine Lighthouse is located in the southeast part of the city. A certain Pokémon usually serves as the lighthouse beacon to safely guide ships into the harbor, but has recently fallen ill.
D11: 2F; from Sailor Huey, after defeating him in a rematch
D12: 3F (Southwest); on the crack in the floor, west of Sailor Kent (hidden)
P6: An elevator leads directly to the beacon room on 6F, but the beacon cannot be reached from this direction. Climb the stairs to 2F instead.
P7: Battle past Gentleman Alfred and Sailor Huey to climb the ladder to 3F.
P8: Fight Bird Keeper Theo and climb the ladder to 4F.
P9: Battle Gentleman Preston, then defeat Lass Connie to reach 招式学习器87（虚张声势） to the west. Exit the building through the east wall. This causes you to fall to a balcony on 3F.
P10: Collect the 神奇糖果 from the west side and re-enter the building.
P11: Defeat Sailor Kent to reach an ＰＰ单项小补剂 to the east, then battle past Bird Keeper Denis to reach the ladder.
P13: Defeat Sailor Terrell, then battle Sailor Roberto and pick up the nearby 白银喷雾 before climbing the ladder.
P14: On the top floor, you find the local Gym Leader, Jasmine, keeping the ill 电龙 company. Amphy would normally use its tail to illuminate the harbor, but does not have the strength for it at the moment. Jasmine informs you of a pharmacy across the sea in 湛蓝市, but she cannot leave the Pokémon unattended. She then unlocks the door to the outer part of the room. Pick up the 好伤药 on the east side and take the elevator back down to 1F.
P15: 40号道路 includes a small beach outside 浅葱市 and a stretch of open ocean leading south to 41号道路. A gate leads northward to an area known as the Battle Frontier, a newly-built venue which is not yet open to the public.
D19: From Monica星期一, after meeting all of the Week Siblings
D20: On the sandy islet to the south (requires 冲浪)
D21: On the sandy islet to the south, underneath TM88 (hidden; requires 冲浪)
P16: 41号道路 is a water route that connects 40号道路 to the north and 湛蓝市 to the west. It is a rough spot in the sea where whirlpools can block the way.
D23:

* Northeast island; southeast of the cave entrance (hidden; requires 潮旋)
* Northwest island; on the northwest part of the beach (hidden; requires 潮旋)
* Southwest island; on the beach in front of the cave entrance (hidden; requires 潮旋)
D24: On the beach of the southwest island (hidden; requires 潮旋)
P17: The 漩涡岛 form an archipelago between the Johto mainland and 湛蓝市. These islands are connected underwater by a sprawling network of dark caves, where seawater and boulders restrict movement in some areas. The rough seas make it impossible to reach them without 潮旋.
